name: Adamsville
source: Adamsville quarter of Atlanta, Fulton County (OSM/Nominatim); its lines run to Plant McDonough and Buzzard Roost in metro Atlanta. The gazetteer's only Georgia Adamsville is a McDuffie County hamlet near Augusta

name: Buzzard Roost
source: Blocked: OSM's only Buzzard Roost substation is Santee Cooper's dam on Lake Greenwood, SC. Georgia Power's is in metro Atlanta (lines to Adamsville and Factory Shoals) and has no public location

name: Factory Shoals
source: Factory Shoals Road SW, Mableton, on the Cobb/Douglas County line west of Atlanta (OSM/Nominatim)

name: Jack McDonough
source: OSM power plant 'Plant McDonough-Atkinson', Smyrna, Cobb County

name: Atkinson
source: Plant Atkinson shares the Plant McDonough-Atkinson site in Cobb County (OSM); lines to Northside Drive and Northwest are in Atlanta. The place gazetteer matched Atkinson County in south Georgia

name: Hammond
source: Plant Hammond on the Coosa River west of Rome, Floyd County (lines to Weiss Dam and Anniston, AL). The place gazetteer matched a Hammond in South Carolina

name: Grady
source: Grady substation is in Atlanta (lines to West End and Morrow); the place gazetteer matched Grady County in southwest Georgia

name: Wateree
source: OSM 'Wateree Substation' beside DESC's Wateree Station, Richland County; OSM's other 'Wateree Dam Substation' is Duke's hydro 35 miles north

name: Killian
source: Killian (Killian Road, northeast Columbia), Richland County; the place gazetteer only knows a Killian in Louisiana

name: Edenwood
source: Edenwood, Cayce, Lexington County (OSM/Nominatim); the other Edenwood is in Augusta, GA, outside DESC's territory

name: Summerville
source: Summerville, Dorchester County (DESC's Summerville 230 kV substation); the other Summerville is in Chattooga County, GA

name: Union Pier
source: Union Pier, Charleston peninsula; the filing gives the need as load growth in the Charleston area

name: Gills Creek
source: Gills Creek, Columbia, Richland County; the filing puts Coit 1.25 miles from it

name: Coit
source: Coit substation, Columbia: the filing converts the 1.25-mile Coit - Gills Creek line
